title: Virtual Assistants Needed Urgently
desc:
Project Overview

We are looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to assist with **creator research, prospect qualification and recruitment administration** for a growing creator-management business.

The role is primarily focused on online research, identifying suitable prospects, verifying publicly available information and maintaining an organized prospect database.

 Responsibilities

* Research potential creators across social-media and livestreaming platforms.
* Identify individual creators who match our provided criteria.
* Verify that profiles are active and authentic.
* Research publicly available professional/business contact information where available.
* Record creator names, usernames, profile URLs and audience information.
* Identify relevant public social-media profiles connected to each prospect.
* Remove duplicate, inactive or unsuitable prospects.
* Maintain an accurate Google Sheets/Excel database.
* Add concise notes explaining why each prospect meets the qualification criteria.
* Assist with initial professional outreach when requested.
* Maintain confidentiality and handle prospect information responsibly.

 Required Skills

* Lead generation
* Web research
* Social-media research
* Data entry
* Google Sheets / Excel
* Prospect qualification
* Strong attention to detail
* Good written English
* Reliable communication

Experience with **creator/influencer research or talent sourcing** is a strong advantage.

title: Copy website and all from given website
desc:
I need the product descriptions from my current website reproduced word-for-word on the new site. Only the text is required—design, images, pricing and SEO fields are outside the scope of this task.

The job involves:  
• Extracting every product description exactly as it appears on the live site, including any HTML tags, bullet points or line breaks.  
• Delivering the copied text in a clean format—either entered directly into the new platform or provided in a CSV/Google Sheet ready for import (whichever you prefer).  

Acceptance criteria  
• Each description must match the source content character-for-character.  
• Spot checks will be run against the original pages before release of payment.

Feel free to use scraping tools or manual copy-paste; accuracy takes priority over method. A quick turnaround is ideal, and I’ll be available to answer questions or verify samples along the way.

title: Instagram & YouTube Stock Market Content
desc:
I need a hands-on partner who can both manage my Instagram and YouTube accounts and build engaging stock market videos entirely from scratch. Your role will start with researching timely market topics, scripting concise explanations, then editing the final “Stock market” videos so they are fast-paced, visually clear, and sized correctly for each platform.

For Instagram you’ll handle feed posts, Reels, Stories, and daily engagement; on YouTube you’ll publish the longer cuts, write SEO-friendly descriptions, and create eye-catching thumbnails. Every piece should feel cohesive across both channels, always reflecting current market moves and my brand voice.

You will:

• Plan a weekly content calendar covering news recaps, trading tips, and evergreen fundamentals  
• Write scripts or bullet outlines, source or design supporting graphics, and record voice-over if needed  
• Edit the footage with clean motion graphics, captions, royalty-free music, and on-screen data pulls  
• Deliver one vertical and one horizontal version of each video, optimized for Instagram and YouTube respectively  
• Track performance in platform analytics and suggest tweaks for higher reach and watch time

Please share links to Instagram or YouTube accounts you currently manage, along with two “stock market” (or similarly data-driven) videos you have edited from scratch. title: Email and File Automation Toolkit
desc:
I’m ready to replace two time-consuming routines—daily email triage and messy download folders—with a single, dependable workflow. Here’s what I need:

1. Email handling automation  
   • Automatically monitor one or more inboxes, identify incoming messages by rule (sender, subject, attachment type, date), and perform actions such as move, label, or forward.  
   • Save attachments straight into the correct folder created by the file-sorting component below.  

2. Smart file sorting  
   • As soon as new files land in a watch folder (from email, downloads, or network share), sort them into a clear folder tree that separates Documents from Media (images & videos) and further sub-organises by date or naming convention we agree on.  
   • Duplicate detection and safe overwrite logic are essential.

I’m open to the toolset—Python (watchdog, imaplib, exchangelib), PowerShell, or a no-code option like Power Automate—as long as it runs reliably on Windows and can be scheduled or triggered in real time.  

Please include:  
• A brief outline of your approach and chosen tech.  
• The runnable script / flow with clear setup instructions.  
• A quick demo (screenshots or short clip) that proves the automation works on sample emails and mixed file types.

I’ll test against a mailbox and a folder packed with PDFs, Word docs, JPEGs, and MP4s; everything should land in its rightful home without manual intervention. Looking forward to streamlining this once and for all.

title: Professional Blog and Website Copy
desc:
I’m updating my site and want a cohesive, professional voice across both the marketing pages and our ongoing content. Specifically, I need:

• Two core pages rewritten: the Home page and the Services page  
• A series of fresh, well-researched blog posts (number to be agreed once we scope topics)

Everything should read crisply and credibly, with clear calls to action and SEO-friendly structure—think logical H1/H2 hierarchy, natural keyword placement, and meta descriptions ready to drop into WordPress. Tone must stay professional throughout, matching an expert B2B audience.

I’ll supply brand guidelines, background on our services, and preliminary keyword lists. Your copy should be original, pass Grammarly and Copyscape checks, and arrive in an editable Google Doc. I’ll review once, send consolidated feedback, and expect a clean final draft after revisions.

If that workflow sounds straightforward, let’s set milestones, lock topics, and get words flowing.

title: Realistic 30-Sec Jedlik Delivery Promo
desc:
I need a tight, 30-second 3D animation that captures the buzz of an IPL evening when every house on one street keeps tapping “Order Now.” In the first beat we see a conventional two-wheeler rider juggling only two food bags per trip; the queue of orders grows, customers frown, and the kitchen dashboard flashes red.  

Cut to the same scene played back with our Jedlik last-mile electric vehicle: one sleek run, the entire street served in a single round. Doors open, steaming meals appear instantly, neighbours exchange smiles and high-fives. The contrast must feel real, energetic and emotionally satisfying—efficiency and customer happiness are the twin messages I want viewers to feel in their gut.

Style & quality  
• Fully realistic 3D look—materials, lighting and motion close to live action.  
• Cinematic but punchy pacing suitable for social feeds and B2B presentations.  
• Subtle graphical overlays (order counter, delivery time) that reinforce the efficiency gain without distracting from the emotion.

Deliverables  
1. Script and storyboard reflecting the IPL-night narrative for sign-off.  
2. All modelling, texturing, animation, lighting and compositing assets.  
3. Final 30-second master in 1080p (mp4) plus clean version for localisation.  
4. Still frames and a 5-second teaser loop for social snippets.

Acceptance

title: Full CPSR for Essential Oil Blend
desc:
I’m ready to take my essential-oil blend to market and need a Full Cosmetic Product Safety Report to clear the final regulatory hurdle. I have the full formulation, each ingredient’s safety data, and the recommended usage instructions prepared and will forward them straight away.

Using that material, please compile Part A (toxicological profile, exposure, margins of safety, etc.) and Part B (your professional safety assessment and conclusion) so the file meets current EU/UK Cosmetic Regulation 1223/2009 requirements. If any additional tests or refinements are necessary, list them clearly so I can arrange them without delay.

Deliverables
• CPSR Part A & Part B in PDF format  
• Supporting calculation sheets or software outputs  
• Brief note on any remaining compliance actions

I’m aiming for a turnaround of about two weeks. When you reply, let me know your safety-assessor credentials and a couple of similar reports you have produced so I can move forward quickly.

title: AI Agent for MARG ERP
desc:
I need an AI-driven assistant that can sit on top of MARG ERP, listen to customers in real time, convert their spoken orders into data, and post those orders as Sale Challans through the standard human UI. The same agent must also be able to pull the resulting numbers from the Sales Invoicing and Reporting modules so that daily summaries can be produced automatically.

Key points you should know  
• Input method: voice only—no manual typing should be required once the call begins.  
• Interaction layer: the agent must navigate the existing windows and dialog boxes of MARG ERP exactly as a person would, not through database back-doors, so screen-automation reliability is critical.  
• Core scope: create, save, and confirm Sale Challans; generate the corresponding sales report on demand or at scheduled intervals.  
• Extensibility: design the workflow so that additional inventory or analytics automations can be plugged in later with minimal re-work.

Deliverables  
1. Fully functioning AI agent installed on one workstation and demonstrated end-to-end: voice call → Sale Challan saved → report exported.  
2. Setup script or step-by-step install guide.  
3. Brief user cheat-sheet for our operators.

I’m flexible on the underlying stack—whether you prefer GPT-4, Dialogflow, or Watson—as long as latency is low and accuracy in recognising Indian names and product codes is high. Show me a short proof-of-concept clip or live demo and we can move quickly to full roll-out.

desc:

title: Format & Publish Story on Wix
desc:
I have a 5,800-word fictional short story ready to go live on my Wix site. All the fonts are already chosen and embedded in the document, and I want the piece to appear online exactly as it reads now—one continuous flow, no chapter breaks, no new styles introduced.

What I need from you:  
• Recreate the story inside my Wix editor, preserving every font change, size shift, and emphasis.  
• Make sure the layout scales cleanly on desktop and mobile.  
• Set up the page URL, basic SEO title/description, and enable comments.  
• Send me a preview link; I’ll do one round of revision notes if needed before we hit Publish.

You’ll get the final Word/Google Doc, the font files (if Wix needs them uploaded), and access to my site as a Contributor. Once the live link matches the original formatting, the job’s done.
